description:
Outcome: After first-version acceptance, the coordinator sees a grid of all 40 plots with current holders, from brief.md item 5, explicitly deferred by owner instruction: Defer the plot map view to after the first version.
Scope: Labelled grid, season context, vacant/allocated status, holders and accessible list alternative; confirm grid layout with owner during this ticket.
Excludes: First-version prototype or launch gate; geographic surveying and drag/drop allocation.
Acceptance: First version already accepted. Exactly 40 distinct plots shown with correct current holdings; refresh reflects allocations; contacts remain coordinator-only; owner validates map layout.
Behaviour: Phone-readable, keyboard-operable, non-colour statuses; empty/no-allocation/error/retry states and readable list alternative.
Verification: Fixture counts, holder/season accuracy, authorization tests and phone/keyboard walkthrough with owner.
Prerequisites: T-002, T-003, T-005, T-007, T-016.
Assumptions: Logical grid; physical arrangement confirmed during this post-v1 ticket, not during first-version checkpoint.
title: Post-v1: coordinator plot map
